1.name: Fully Automatic High-Precision Laminating Machine
1.summary: Designed specifically for glass and display module assembly. Lamination accuracy reaches ±0.075mm, equipped with constant pressure control, and cycle time as fast as 80 seconds.
1.contentHtml:
The Fully Automatic High-Precision Laminating Machine is a high-end intelligent equipment independently developed by TXAM, designed for high-precision lamination of glass and display modules.

Working Principle

The equipment uses precision mechanical structures combined with advanced motion control systems to achieve automatic feeding, precise positioning, high-precision lamination, and pressure holding. The entire process is automatically controlled to ensure lamination accuracy and quality consistency.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy up to ±0.075mm, far exceeding industry standards
  • Constant pressure function ensures firm lamination without bubbles
  • 80-second ultra-fast cycle time, significantly improving production efficiency
  • Supports multiple product sizes with high flexibility

Application Areas

Widely used in glass lamination processes for electronic products such as TVs, educational displays, and commercial display screens.

2.name: OC Intelligent Lamination System
2.summary: Fully automatic precision assembly of Open Cell and backlight modules. Uses UVW vision alignment platform to completely solve screen breakage issues caused by manual lamination.
2.contentHtml:
The OC Intelligent Lamination System is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the core processes of display panel manufacturing.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a UVW vision alignment platform to automatically identify product positions and guide robots to complete precision assembly of OC and backlight modules. The fully automatic process includes automatic feeding, foam collection, and empty box collection.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy from ±0.15mm to ±0.4mm
  • Fixed cycle time of 25 seconds, ensuring production rhythm
  • Completely solves screen breakage issues caused by manual lamination
  • One-button product changeover, reducing changeover time

Model Description

The TXM-A series includes models such as 151B, 201B, and 401B, with main differences in compatible product sizes and lamination accuracy.

3.name: TV/Commercial Display Flexible Assembly Line
3.summary: Fully automated from dispensing, bracket placement, lamination, flip inspection to final bagging and palletizing. One-button compatibility with multiple sizes (including 65~110" ultra-large screens).
3.contentHtml:
The TV/Commercial Display Flexible Assembly Line is a turnkey engineering solution provided by TXAM for display equipment manufacturers.

Line Composition

The entire line covers the full process from core assembly (dispensing, bracket placement, lamination), intermediate processes (flipping, visual inspection), to final packaging (bagging, uprighting, palletizing).

Technical Advantages

  • One-button compatibility with 65~110" multi-size products
  • Entire line uses robotic automation
  • CAD import for one-button changeover, short debugging time
  • High overall yield rate and consistent product quality

Service Model

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, to after-sales service, truly achieving turnkey engineering.

4.name: High-Precision Robotic Dispensing Machine
4.summary: Single-axis robot with multi-nozzle matrix, positioning error ±0.2mm, single-line dispensing only 0.25 seconds. Seamless CAD drawing import, one-button changeover.
4.contentHtml:
The High-Precision Robotic Dispensing Machine is a core equipment developed by TXAM for precision coating processes.

Working Principle

Uses a single-axis robot with a multi-nozzle matrix, achieving fast and uniform dispensing through a precision motion control system. Supports direct import of CAD drawings to automatically generate dispensing paths.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning error only ±0.2mm, industry-leading accuracy
  • Dispensing speed of 0.25 seconds per line, extremely high efficiency
  • Supports one-button CAD drawing import for convenient changeover
  • TCP/IP communication protocol, easy integration into smart factory systems

Model Description

The TX-NS-AGD-01 uses a fixture tray format, while the TX-NS-AGD-02 uses direct backplane feeding, with the main difference being the line compatibility method.

5.name: Automatic Spray Gluing Machine
5.summary: Sprays glue evenly onto target objects, suitable for larger panels. High spraying efficiency and strong compatibility, from 75" to full-size panels.
5.contentHtml:
The automatic spray gluing machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for large panel gluing needs.

Working Principle

The device uses a glue block melter for material supply, heating and melting solid glue blocks, which are then evenly coated onto the product surface through a spray nozzle. Spray speed is fast, and coating is uniform.

Technical Advantages

  • Spray speed 0.6-0.8m/s, industry-leading efficiency
  • Compatible sizes from 75" to full-size, wide application range
  • Multiple models available: TX-NS-ASM-01/02/03
  • Can be used with vision or mechanical positioning

6.name: Automatic Light Bracket Placement Machine
6.summary: Precisely picks and places diffusion brackets, providing stable support for display device optical components. Accurate positioning and high-speed picking.
6.contentHtml:
The automatic light bracket placement machine is used for precise placement of diffusion bracket columns during display product assembly.

Working Principle

The device uses a vibration bowl for automatic material feeding, and a robot precisely picks bracket columns and places them at designated positions. Positioning accuracy reaches ±0.2mm, with a picking speed of 1 second per piece.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy ±0.2mm, ensuring assembly precision
  • High-speed picking, capable of thousands per hour
  • Vibration bowl automatic feeding reduces manual intervention
  • Multiple models TX-NS-ALPS-01/02/03, adaptable to different sizes and production needs

7.name: Automatic Light Bar Placement Machine
7.summary: Precisely and quickly places LED light bars at designated positions. Can pick multiple light bars at once, with pressure holding function to ensure assembly accuracy.
7.contentHtml:
The automatic light bar placement machine uses a robot unit to automate light bar placement.

Working Principle

Using a robot with a vision system, it can precisely pick 7 light bars and place them at target positions in one go. The device features a pressure holding function to ensure light bars are firmly fixed.

Technical Advantages

  • Assembly accuracy ±0.2mm
  • Can pick 7 light bars at once, high efficiency
  • Pressure holding function ensures assembly quality
  • Supports CAD import for quick changeover

8.name: Robot Automatic Backplate Screw Machine
8.summary: Can pick and automatically tighten up to 12 backplate screws at once, with real-time adjustable torque per screw, achieving efficiency of 1.8 seconds per screw.
8.contentHtml:
The robot automatic backplate screw machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for precision screw fastening processes.

Working Principle

The device uses a robot with an intelligent fastening system, capable of picking 12 screws at once and automatically fastening them onto the product. Torque is adjustable in real-time, ensuring consistent fastening torque for each screw.

Technical Advantages

  • Can pick 12 screws at once, reducing feeding frequency
  • Fastening speed 1.8 seconds per screw, extremely high efficiency
  • Real-time adjustable torque ensures fastening quality
  • Suitable for backplate fastening of TVs, educational displays, etc.

9.name: 180-Degree Heavy-Duty Flip Machine
9.summary: Designed for flipping large or heavy products, achieving precise 180-degree flipping. Solves issues such as difficulty and safety risks in manual flipping due to process requirements.
9.contentHtml:
The 180-degree heavy-duty flip machine is a core device developed by TXAM for flipping large and heavy products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision mechanical structure combined with a servo drive system to achieve one-button 180-degree flipping. The flipping process is smooth with precise positioning, effectively solving the difficulties and safety hazards of manual flipping.

Technical Advantages

  • Flipping cycle time of 15-55 seconds, high efficiency
  • One-button operation, simple and convenient
  • High load capacity, suitable for large products such as TVs and educational displays
  • Multiple models available: TXM-B-105 series (A/B/C) and 205A

10.name: Automatic Tempered Glass Frame Installation Machine
10.summary: Designed for automatic installation of tempered glass frames on educational displays. Uses vision positioning with accuracy up to ±0.15mm.
10.contentHtml:
The automatic tempered glass frame installation machine is an automated assembly unit developed by TXAM for educational display products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a CCD vision system to automatically identify product positions, guiding the robot to complete precise tempered glass frame installation. Positioning accuracy reaches ±0.15mm.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.15mm, industry-leading
  • Uses vision positioning, strong adaptability
  • TX-NS-ACTGR-02 model offers faster cycle time
  • Specifically designed for educational display products

11.name: Six-Axis Robot Intelligent Palletizing System
specs: Compatible with Master and Slave Pallets
11.summary: Perfectly solves the challenge of palletizing heavy finished products. Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets, with accuracy controlled within ±0.5mm and speed up to 12 seconds per piece.
11.contentHtml:
The six-axis robot intelligent palletizing system is a core device developed by TXAM for post-production logistics automation.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a six-axis industrial robot (optional ABB, Yaskawa, etc.) combined with an intelligent control system to achieve automatic product palletizing. Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets, with strong compatibility.

Technical Advantages

  • Palletizing accuracy of ±0.5mm, neat and stable stacking
  • Efficiency up to 12 seconds per piece
  • Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets
  • Compatible with products of different sizes and shapes

Model Description

TX-NS-PR series (01/02/03) and integrated palletizing TX-NS-RIP-001, the latter with more powerful functions including master/slave pallet stacking, automatic pad placement, scanning, etc.

12.name: End-of-Line Front-Loading Packaging Automatic Box Packing System
12.summary: Integrates automatic pallet stacking (skid), box unpacking, forming, and product boxing. Mechanical rigid positioning with full compatibility, completing single skid centering in 20 seconds.
12.contentHtml:
The end-of-line front-loading packaging automatic box packing system is an automated device developed by TXAM for post-production packaging processes.

Working Principle

The equipment integrates an automatic palletizer, box unpacker, box former, and box packer to achieve full automation of the post-production packaging process. One-button operation automatically completes pallet stacking and centering.

Technical Advantages

  • Pallet centering cycle time of only 20 seconds per piece
  • Mechanical rigid positioning, stronger compatibility
  • Allows a certain range of pallet offset
  • Multiple models available: TX-NS-AET-01/02/03

13.name: Robot Integrated Palletizing Solution
13.summary: A more powerful integrated palletizing solution, including special functions such as master-slave pallet stacking, automatic pallet insertion, and scanning.
13.contentHtml:
The robot integrated palletizing solution is a full-featured palletizing system developed by TXAM for high-end customers.

Working Principle

Based on standard palletizing functions, it integrates master-slave pallet stacking, automatic pallet insertion, scanning, and other functions to achieve full automation of the post-production logistics process.

Technical Advantages

  • Complete functions covering the entire post-production logistics process
  • Master-slave pallet stacking function for more application scenarios
  • Automatic pallet insertion to reduce manual intervention
  • Scanning function for traceable logistics information

14.name: Robot Upright Unit
14.summary: Automatically converts products from horizontal to vertical state. Uses CCD vision to determine product position, and the robot automatically picks and completes the upright action.
14.contentHtml:
The robot upright unit is an automated device developed by TXAM for product posture conversion.

Working Principle

The device uses a CCD vision system to automatically determine product position, guiding a six-axis robot to pick up the product and complete the posture conversion from horizontal to vertical. The upright process is smooth, effectively protecting product safety.

Technical Advantages

  • CCD vision guidance for accurate positioning
  • Smooth upright process to avoid product damage
  • Significant labor savings and improved efficiency
  • Customizable based on different product characteristics

15.name: Auxiliary Vision Inspection Unit
15.summary: Assists or replaces manual product appearance quality inspection through automatic flipping and image recognition. Solves the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.
15.contentHtml:
The auxiliary vision inspection unit is an automated auxiliary device developed by TXAM for product quality inspection.

Working Principle

The device automatically flips products and works with an image recognition system to assist in completing product appearance quality inspection. Effectively solves the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping function solves the difficulty of flipping heavy products
  • Works with vision system to improve inspection accuracy
  • Significantly improves appearance inspection efficiency
  • Reduces employee labor intensity

16.name: Automatic Pressure Holding Unit
16.summary: Applies and maintains constant pressure on assembled components to ensure bonding or assembly process quality. Precise pressure control and long pressure holding time.
16.contentHtml:
The automatic pressure holding unit is an automated device developed by TXAM for bonding processes.

Working Principle

The device applies constant pressure to products after dispensing, lamination, and other processes, ensuring the adhesive fully cures and assembly quality remains consistent.

Technical Advantages

  • Precise pressure control ensures bonding quality
  • Long pressure holding time adapts to different process requirements
  • Strong adaptability for use with various products
  • Automated operation reduces manual intervention

17.name: Industrial Brain Control Software R&D
17.summary: Deep integration of software and hardware, self-developed WMS, WCS, MES, and underlying TCP/IP visual communication components. Break down workshop information silos and achieve digital transparent management.
17.contentHtml:
Industrial Brain Control Software is a software system independently developed by TXAM for the implementation of smart factories.

System Composition

The system includes WMS (Warehouse Management System), WCS (Warehouse Control System), MES (Manufacturing Execution System), and underlying TCP/IP visual communication components.

Technical Advantages

  • Break down workshop information silos to achieve data interconnection
  • Real-time monitoring of equipment status and production data
  • Digital transparent management to improve management efficiency
  • Supports TCP/IP communication for seamless integration with various equipment

Application Scenarios

Suitable for intelligent upgrading and transformation of various automated production lines to achieve true smart manufacturing.

18.name: Rotary Table
18.summary: A precision rotary device for multi-station processing or inspection of products, enabling multi-angle automated handling.
18.contentHtml:
The Rotary Table is an automated unit equipment developed by TXAM for multi-station processing needs.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision servo drive system to achieve multi-angle rotation and positioning of products. Combined with an automated loading and unloading system, it can complete multi-station processes such as machining, inspection, and assembly.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision positioning with high repeatability
  • Multi-station design to improve production efficiency
  • High level of automation to reduce manual intervention
  • Strong adaptability for use with various products

19.name: Lifting Unit
19.summary: A lifting and conveying device for transferring products between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless height integration on production lines.
19.contentHtml:
The Lifting Unit is an automated conveying device developed by TXAM for height connection on production lines.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a servo drive system combined with precision guide rails to achieve smooth lifting of products. It is suitable for product transfer between workstations at different heights, enabling seamless connection on production lines.

Technical Advantages

  • Smooth lifting with high load capacity
  • Automated control for perfect integration with production lines
  • Stable structure with long service life
  • Customizable stroke and load

20.name: Module Transfer Machine
20.summary: A precision device for automatic transfer of electronic modules between different workstations, supporting multiple product sizes.
20.contentHtml:
The Module Transfer Machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for transferring electronic modules.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision motion control system to achieve accurate transfer of modules between multiple workstations. Combined with a visual positioning system, it can adapt to precise transfer of products of different sizes.

Technical Advantages

  • High transfer accuracy with precise product positioning
  • Supports multi-station configuration with high flexibility
  • High level of automation to reduce manual intervention
  • Easy changeover for multi-variety production

21.name: Automatic Trigger Locking
21.summary: Automated equipment for installing clips or triggers, featuring precision positioning and rapid snap-fit assembly.
21.contentHtml:
Automatic Trigger Locking is an automated device developed by TXAM for clip assembly.

Working Principle

The equipment uses precision mechanical structures combined with servo drives to automatically pick, position, and install clips or triggers. It is equipped with a vision inspection system to ensure snap-fit quality.

Technical Advantages

  • Automated snap-fit assembly with high efficiency
  • Precision positioning for high assembly accuracy
  • Vision inspection ensures quality
  • Adapts to products of various sizes

22.name: Auxiliary Bag Sealer
22.summary: Automated sealing equipment for product packaging bags, using heat sealing technology for neat and strong seals.
22.contentHtml:
Auxiliary Bag Sealer is an automated device developed by TXAM for the packaging sealing process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses heat sealing technology to automatically seal product packaging bags. Combined with an automatic feeding system, it achieves full automation of the sealing process.

Technical Advantages

  • Heat sealing technology for neat and strong seals
  • High automation level and efficiency
  • Stable quality control with consistent sealing quality
  • Easy operation and low maintenance costs

23.name: Robot Offline Bagging
23.summary: Works with robots to automatically bag products after offline, achieving full automation in post-packaging.
23.contentHtml:
Robot Offline Bagging Machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for the post-packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works with a six-axis robot to automatically pick packaging bags and place them over products, enabling automated bagging for offline products.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automation for high efficiency
  • Precise bagging position for better product protection
  • High automation level reduces manual labor
  • Adapts to various product sizes

24.name: Robot Automatic Backplane Placement
24.summary: Automated equipment for automatically placing backplanes into product assembly stations, working with robots for precision assembly.
24.contentHtml:
Robot Automatic Backplane Placement Machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for the backplane placement process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot combined with a precision positioning system to automatically pick and place backplanes into product assembly stations. It works in coordination with assembly robots to achieve full automation of backplane installation.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automatic placement for high efficiency
  • Precise positioning ensures assembly accuracy
  • High automation level reduces manual intervention
  • Stable quality control for consistent product quality

25.name: Packaging and Logistics Automation Equipment
25.summary: System integration solutions for logistics automation covering the entire process of post-production packaging, conveying, and sorting.
25.contentHtml:
Packaging and logistics automation equipment is a system integration solution developed by TXAM for post-production logistics.

System Composition

The system includes automatic packaging equipment, conveyor lines, sorting equipment, and warehouse management systems, achieving full automation of post-production logistics.

Technical Advantages

  • System integration, full automation of logistics processes
  • Efficient sorting, improving logistics efficiency
  • Intelligent management, digital transparency
  • Customizable according to customer needs

26.name: Robot Cell Equipment
26.summary: Modular cell equipment centered on robots, flexibly configurable and integrable based on process requirements.
26.contentHtml:
Robot cell equipment is a modular automation device developed by TXAM for flexible production.

Working Principle

The equipment is centered on a six-axis robot, paired with various end-of-arm tools and auxiliary devices to form a modular cell. It can be flexibly configured according to different process requirements, enabling multi-function use of a single machine.

Technical Advantages

  • Modular design, flexible configuration
  • Multi-function use, improving equipment utilization
  • Easy integration into existing production lines
  • Efficient and reliable, simple maintenance

27.name: Auxiliary Loading Tilt Unit
27.summary: Auxiliary tilt device for product loading stations, working with main equipment to achieve automated loading and unloading.
27.contentHtml:
The auxiliary loading tilt unit is an auxiliary tilt device developed by TXAM for production line loading stations.

Working Principle

The equipment works with the main production line to automatically tilt and position products at the loading station, preparing for the next process.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic tilt, improving loading efficiency
  • Efficient coordination with main equipment
  • Quality assurance, reducing product damage
  • Simple operation, low maintenance cost

28.name: Auxiliary Unloading Tilt Unit
28.summary: Auxiliary tilt device for product unloading stations, working with main equipment to achieve automated unloading.
28.contentHtml:
The auxiliary unloading tilt unit is an auxiliary tilt device developed by TXAM for production line unloading stations.

Working Principle

The equipment works with the main production line to automatically tilt and collect products at the unloading station, preparing for post-production packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic tilt, improving unloading efficiency
  • Efficient coordination with main equipment
  • Quality assurance, reducing product damage
  • Simple operation, low maintenance cost

29.name: Manual-assisted bagging
29.summary: Manual-assisted bagging equipment, working with automated machinery to complete product bagging packaging.
29.contentHtml:
The manual-assisted bagging machine is an auxiliary device developed by TXAM for the bagging packaging process.

Working Principle

The equipment works with manual operation to achieve semi-automated bagging packaging, improving packaging efficiency while reducing equipment investment.

Technical Advantages

  • Combination of manual and automation, flexible and efficient
  • Guaranteed bagging quality
  • Reduced equipment investment costs
  • Easy operation, low training costs

30.name: Robot automatic hanging on conveyor chain
30.summary: Automated equipment that works with robots to automatically hang products onto an overhead conveyor chain.
30.contentHtml:
The robot automatic hanging machine is an automated device developed by TXAM for overhead conveyor systems.

Working Principle

The equipment works with a six-axis robot to automatically pick up and hang products onto the overhead conveyor chain, enabling automatic product loading for overhead transport.

Technical Advantages

  • Robot-automated chain hanging, high efficiency
  • Overhead conveyor, saving floor space
  • High degree of automation, reducing labor
  • Perfect integration with production line

31.name: TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solution
31.summary: Full-line automation solution for TV and commercial display manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
31.contentHtml:
The TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solution is a turnkey project solution provided by TXAM for display manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including dispensing, bracket placement, lamination, flip inspection, and final packaging, achieving fully automated production from raw materials to finished products.

Solution Advantages

  • One-key compatibility for 65~110 inch multi-size products
  • Full-process robotic automation
  • CAD import for one-key changeover, short debugging time
  • High overall yield, consistent product quality
  • True turnkey project implementation

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
